title: Natural Instructions: Benchmarking generalization to new tasks from natural language instructions

numbers.sentence: Our results indicate that models benefit from instructions when evaluated in terms of generalization to unseen tasks (19% better for models utilizing instructions).
For example, a BART achieves a 19% gain in terms of cross-task generalization compared to a model not using instructions ( ).
The subsequent evaluation of the human-generated responses results in more than 96% accuracy, which indicates that humans can effortlessly understand and execute our instructions.
Table shows data statistics for each task category. On average, instructions contain 4.9 positive examples and 2.2 negative examples.
Table shows data statistics for each task category. On average, instructions contain 4.9 positive examples and 2.2 negative examples.
For example, under random split, the model using Full Instructions results in +19% gains over a model that is not using instructions.
For example, a BART models using Full Instructions achieves 8% higher performance than GPT3 under random split of tasks.
On average, task-specific models score 66% which is considerably higher than our models' best generalization (32%; Table ).
On average, task-specific models score 66% which is considerably higher than our models' best generalization (32%; Table ).
For example, QASC and MCTACO include 7 and 19 steps in the data creation process, respectively.
The longest element of instructions is usually Definitions with 65.5 tokens and the shortest is title with 8.3 tokens (more statistics in Table ).
The longest element of instructions is usually Definitions with 65.5 tokens and the shortest is title with 8.3 tokens (more statistics in Table ).
Implementation details. For BART, our models are trained for 3 epochs with a learning rate of 5e-5 for a given training split and input encoding.

rows.text: Identify crowdsourced dataset and engage with their authors.
Go through the template and understand the task.
Manually fill fields in the schema with content from the template.
Iterate over the instructions to ensure their clarity while eliminating the repeated content. Fix writing issue in examples, also typos etc.
Create negative examples if not present. Add the missing explanations to the examples.
Extract the input/output instances from raw crowdsourcing annotations.
Final inspections of the data to verify the data quality

foundation.sentence: We build models using pre-trained LMs with encoder-decoder architectures BART [Lewis et al. 2019] for fine-tuning and GPT3 [Brown et al. 2020] for few-shot experiments. Encoding instructions and instances. For every problem setup, we map a given instruction I_t and an input instance x into a textual format and decode an output y and obtain enc(I_t, x).
